plan.notes: Hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from Webster University's official 'Undergraduate Course Sequence and Degree Plans | College of Humanities and Social Sciences' page (History and Political Science), Four-Year Program Sequence, Effective Catalog 2026-2027. Program name follows the 2026-2027 official catalog majors index ('History and Political Science (BA)'). Semester totals match the page's stated totals (15 + 15 + 16 + 15 + 15 + 15 + 15 + 14 = 120). Page header bands: GCP 27 / Major 36 / Elective 57 = 120, consistent with the sequence. The source marks emphasis choices: '*' = History emphasis, '^' = Political Science emphasis; choice slots quote the source's wording. 'HIST/INTL 1000' and 'HIST/POLT 1200' are cross-listed codes as printed. HIST/POLT 4000 Research Requirement is a 0-credit required checkpoint (required_zero). Prerequisites are not listed in the sequence; prereq arrays are empty (chains live in the catalog course descriptions).
